summary: First Majestic Silver filed a 6-K attaching an October 8, 2026 news release reporting Q3 2026 production of 3.4 Moz silver and 29,552 oz gold from four Mexican underground mines, plus Q3 conference-call details and renewal of its share repurchase program. Silver hit 72% and gold 75% of revised 2026 guidance midpoints, hurt by a 12-day labour dispute at San Dimas. Up to 33 rigs drilled roughly 78,475 m. Jerritt Canyon restart runs ahead of plan. No transactional terms, advisor, or recommendation is stated; routine operational disclosure with a buyback renewal.
